ttft_root_cause.finding: Layerwise serving reads identical bytes (308.05 MB/followup, 65 preads) but TTFT mean is 1.124x uniform on HOLD (279.80 vs 248.94 ms; paired +30.9 ms [29.7, 32.0]).
ttft_root_cause.cause: Cold pread throughput per file depends on file size: ~2.0 GB/s for ~2 MB back-layer files vs ~3.6-4.0 GB/s for 5-6 MB files (block read_ahead_kb = 128). A1-2 moves rows from mid/back layers (small files) to layers 0-2 (clipped at 0.60), so the same bytes are spread over more small reads.
